rationale: Fama and French (1992), 'The Cross-Section of Expected Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 47(2). Canonical empirical cross-sectional asset-pricing paper. (1) Data section: §I.A 'Data' specifies the CRSP NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ return files intersected with merged COMPUSTAT annual industrial files, nonfinancial firms, Compustat 1962-1989, returns July 1963-December 1990. (2) Methodology: yearly portfolio sorts (size, pre-ranking beta, 100 size-beta portfolios, size-BE/ME, BE/ME, E/P) with equal-weighted monthly returns, Dimson sum-beta estimation on post-ranking portfolio returns, and Fama-MacBeth monthly cross-sectional regressions of individual stock returns on beta, ln(ME), ln(BE/ME), ln(A/ME), ln(A/BE), E/P dummy, E(+)/P. (3) Tables of numerical results: Tables I-VI (portfolio average returns, post-ranking betas, average size, characteristic averages, FM slopes with t-statistics, subperiod FM results) plus appendix Tables AI-AII for 1941-1990 NYSE. (4) Sample period and data sources fully specified. (5) Variables fully operationalized: BE = book common equity + balance-sheet deferred taxes; E = income before extraordinary items + income-statement deferred taxes - preferred dividends; ratios measured with December t-1 ME; size ln(ME) in June t; accounting data for fiscal years ending in calendar year t-1 matched to July t-June t+1 returns.
